messages:
kevin: Starting quiet window deploy for v2026.03. Rolling canary to 10% now. Please eyeball SLO dashboards (link: https://dash.redwood.local/slo/serve) and flag any 5xx or p95 regressions.

deploy-bot: Deploy triggered by kevin. Canary traffic: 10%. Version: v2026.03. Canary target: eu-west-1. CI status: green. Notify: @eng-oncall.

maria: watching p95 for embeds-route — saw a small bump to 380ms 2m ago, baseline ~220ms. Not trending yet but spiking in eu-west-1. Not seeing 5xx yet. :eyes:

liz: pulling logs now. quick query: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="serve",route="/embeds"}[1m])) by (status)` -> 200 ok, 500 count steady at ~0.1/min. I can widen sampling if it persists.

ops-sre: if p95 stays >300ms for next 5m we should pause the rollout + pin the version for eu-west. Recommend throttling canary ramp to 0% and divert to previous stable. Prep rollback playbook: `rollback v2026.02 -> traffic shift 100% in 30s`.

kevin: copy. pausing ramp. @deploy-bot hold-ramp. Also adding note to release notes: potential eu-west perf variance on embeds.

deploy-bot: Action acknowledged: hold-ramp. Canary remains at 10%. Autoscaler unaffected.

maria: while we watch, can someone sanity-check KV cache hit rate? I suspect cold cache after the new model shard layout. `kv_cache_hit_ratio{region="eu-west-1"}` looks low.

liz: kv hit ratio snapshot: 0.62 -> baseline 0.88. yep, cold. Suggest prewarm job: `tools/prewarm_kv --region eu-west-1 --model embeds-v2` (I can kick it if ops-sre gives thumbs).

ops-sre: thumbs. start prewarm. I'll keep an eye on 5xx and p95. If prewarm brings hit ratio >0.8 within 10m we can resume ramp. Otherwise rollback.

kevin: starting prewarm now. tagging ENG-RELEASES in the release notes draft. Also noting to customers: "brief performance variance in eu-west during rollouts".

maria: p95 trending down to 240ms, kv hit ratio moving to 0.75. no 5xx. looks promising.

liz: logs show a handful of transient timeouts from a single proxy pod, restarted it just in case.

ops-sre: pod restart completed, error counts at 0 again. p95 stable ~230ms. recommend resume ramp to 25% and keep monitoring.

kevin: resume ramp to 25%. @deploy-bot ramp-to 25% with 5m hold.

deploy-bot: Ramp command accepted: target 25% over 2m, hold 5m. Will alert if 5xx or p95 > alert thresholds.

maria: good to go. I'll update the release note line and mark the quiet window as "monitoring - no rollback" for now.

kevin: thanks all. if anything flares up, we'll execute rollback. otherwise, keep an eye for the next 15m and then full rollout. :white_check_mark:
